newsitem.title: USA: Digital to fill board in "normal process".
newsitem.headline: Digital to fill board in "normal process".

text.p: Digital Equipment Corp is continually looking for qualified candidates for its board of directors, unrelated to pressure from a shareholder activist to change the makeup of the board, a spokesman said.

"Looking for qualified candidates for our board is a normal process and it's not related in any way to recent shareholder activity," spokesman Dan Kaferle said. "We're always looking for qualified candidates."

Herbert Denton, president of Providence Capital Corp, recently held a meeting in New York where he said 30 to 40 percent of Digital stockholders gathered to discuss Digital's problems. Denton said that Digital should change its board to add some younger members.
Kaferle left open the question of when the company would name a replacement for Robert Everett, who retired from the nine-member board last November.
"His spot has been open for the last eight or nine months," Kaferle said. "I can't speculate on when we would fill that position."

Three members of the board of directors are up for re-election at the shareholders meeting this November and the remaining five members have staggered terms and are not up for re-election this year, he said.
